hook: A little color. A little room to create.
voiceIdentity: Off-screen female narrator: a Filipina woman around 28 years old, with a warm, clear, conversational mid-range voice and smooth natural resonance. She sounds friendly, confident, curious and lightly playful, like a thoughtful friend helping someone choose a personal fragrance. Speak natural conversational Taglish with fluid Tagalog-English code-switching and a natural Filipina accent. Follow the exact supplied Taglish script; do not translate it into all-English or formal Tagalog. Keep scent names and website button labels unchanged. Keep a subtle smile in the voice, crisp diction, gently varied intonation and relaxed conversational pacing. Emphasize product names and key offer conditions clearly. Preserve the same age, accent, pitch range and vocal texture across every shot. Narration is off-screen; do not introduce a talking person or visible mouth. No shouting, forced whispering, exaggerated accent, celebrity imitation or robotic sales cadence.
voiceDirection: Ask the opening buyer question with curiosity, then offer the named scent or brand answer helpfully. Gentle, imaginative and inviting, with a quiet sense of curiosity.
